Syrian officials say thousands of civilians are still trying to flee the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces strongholds of Deir Hafer and Maskanah – east of Aleppo. There's a tense standoff in the contested areas after the Syrian army boosted its presence there. The military has set up a humanitarian corridor to get civilians out but the SDF has now set up checkpoints and is turning people back.

Al Jazeera’s Zein Basravi reports from Hmeimeh village.

description:
US President Donald Trump is threatening to use an emergency law to send federal troops into the state of Minnesota, following days of angry protests against ICE. It comes more than a week after a US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent fatally shot a woman in Minneapolis. Multiple senior federal prosecutors in Washington, DC, and Minnesota are leaving their jobs amid turmoil over the Trump administration's handling of the investigation.

Al Jazeera’s John Hendren reports from Washington.
